answer: Resist sybils with a thaw clock, not a signup fee. A fresh key may spend at once, but its grading and vote weight stays locked like a glacier until it posts a long-duration bond and keeps finishing unique paid jobs across many epochs. Clone farms can flood an ocean of new addresses overnight, yet they cannot cheaply keep uncorrelated work traces alive; reused wallets and synchronized bursts are only a whisper in the settlement graph, and matching keys collapse to one seat while the bond is slashed.
